# Mission Canvas

> Software built around how your business works, running on your own computers. We audit the workflow, build the application and hand it over. No per-seat fees.

Mission Canvas builds private AI software for small and mid-sized businesses. Each engagement starts with a workflow audit, then the application is built from a working starting point for the industry (a "canvas") and runs on the business's own computers. One job, one fixed price, quoted after the audit. 25% at signing, 75% on delivery and acceptance. Never per seat, no subscription. Get started: https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/

## Main pages

- [Mission Canvas: private AI software for small businesses](https://pretendhome.github.io/): Software built around how your business works, running on your own computers. We audit the workflow, build the application and hand it over. No per-seat fees.
- [Get Started](https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/): Bring the job that keeps coming back. Pick a time and a video link comes with the booking.
- [Private AI software by industry](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/): Private AI software for construction, schools, logistics, front desks, events and venues, clinics and back offices. Find a canvas that gets you close; we make it fit.
- [Private AI software for small businesses: questions answered](https://pretendhome.github.io/faq): Answers to what owners ask about private AI software before an audit: what it is, what it costs, who owns it, and where the data goes.
- [I built an AI automation for my business and it keeps breaking. Who can help me finish it?](https://pretendhome.github.io/finish-a-stuck-ai-automation): Bring one example of where the work stops and what the person doing the job expected to happen next. Mission Canvas can review the job, scope a build around it and hand the finished tool over to your team.
- [My clients are asking about AI. How can an IT provider help without putting client data into public tools?](https://pretendhome.github.io/for-it-providers/clients-asking-about-ai): Mission Canvas helps IT providers scope a job that can run on the client’s machines. Pick one job with the client first. Ask which files it uses, who checks the result and whether any part needs an outside service. You can use that conversation to scope a tool that runs on the client’s own machines.
- [How it works](https://pretendhome.github.io/how-it-works): What happens to your files, step by step, and what working with Mission Canvas looks like, from the audit to handover in four to six weeks.
- [Palette: a free local AI app for your documents](https://pretendhome.github.io/palette): A free local AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Give it one folder. It reads only what you allow, on your computer, and links every line to its source.
- [Pricing: one job, one fixed price](https://pretendhome.github.io/pricing): One job, one fixed price, quoted after the audit. 25% at signing, 75% on delivery and acceptance. Never per seat, no subscription.
- [Can a small firm use AI on confidential client files without uploading them anywhere?](https://pretendhome.github.io/private-ai-for-confidential-files): Yes. Mission Canvas builds tools that read the files your firm chooses on its own computers. Start with a sample folder and ask it a question whose answer you already know. Check the source before you try the same job with client material.
- [Private, on-premise AI: your files stay on your computers](https://pretendhome.github.io/security): Your files are read on your own computers. Agree what is read, what may leave and how the team checks the result.

## Industries

- [Construction job costing and fleet software](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/construction): Construction job costing and fleet software: job sites, the office and the fleet in one system, with AI doing the back-office work, on your own computers.
- [Private AI for schools: student lenses and parent summaries](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/education): Private AI for schools: teachers say what they noticed and each student’s lens updates with what works, accommodations and CEFR milestones, on your own machines.
- [Ticketing and access control software for venues](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/events-venues): Ticketing and access control software for events and venues: online sales, the gate, the box office and your visitor list in one system.
- [Private patient check-in and scheduling software](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/healthcare): Patient check-in, scheduling and queues for clinics, with patient data kept on your own computers. In progress: get started to shape it.
- [Order tracking software for small logistics companies](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/logistics): Order tracking software for small logistics companies: orders, stages and customer updates in one place, checked overnight on your own computers.
- [Invoice processing automation for small businesses](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/office): Invoice processing automation for small businesses: invoices read, checked and filed, and the repetitive back-office work done on your own computers.
- [AI receptionist for small businesses: phone, WhatsApp, email](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/voice-front-desk): An AI receptionist for small businesses: it answers the phone, WhatsApp and email, books and reschedules on your calendar, and hands over to a person.
